messages:
Aaron: Heads-up — after the 1.4.2 scrub-job roll we've seen a sustained drop in prefix cache hit rate for the web-chat workload. 82% -> ~68% across the last 6h. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/infracloud/kvcache/teams/web-chat
Priya: Ugh. Seen that on the alert too. Any idea if this aligns with the TTL compaction flag change from that deploy?
Aaron: Yeah I suspect the TTL scrub interval tweak (PR #4213) might be more aggressive and causing early eviction of warm prefixes. Need a quick hypothesis check: is this real eviction + fragmentation, or are prefetch paths missing due to reindexing?
Sam: I skimmed the PR — it reduces scrub-window to 30m from 6h for stale TTLs. That could surface short-lived prefixes. Also cc @Tina — compaction code touched shard reclamation.
Tina: I can run a targeted staging profile. What do we want collected? occupancy, eviction events, fragmentation histo, and KV walk snap at t0/t1.
Aaron: Exactly. Also want to capture per-shard hit-rate, and a sample of longest-lived prefixes (top 100) pre/post. If we can run a perf flame for the scrub thread that'd help.
Priya: I'll queue a staging run now. Command I'll use:
```
./bin/kvcache-bench --workload=web-chat --duration=30m --capture=occupancy,evictions,frag,hits --out=/tmp/bench-1865432100
```
Priya: Question — should I enable \`--prefetch\` or keep it off? The prod config has prefetch=on, but the scrub experiment was done with prefetch=false.
Sam: Run both if possible. Start with prefetch=false to reproduce prod-scrub mismatch, then flip prefetch=true. Two short runs (30m each) should be fine.
perf-bot: Alert posted: kvcache.hitrate.web-chat dropped below threshold (70%) at 1865429001. Correlation check: latest deploy 1.4.2. Links: /alerts/9876
Tina: I'll add a KV inspector snapshot before the run:
```
./scripts/kv_inspect --shard all --sample 1000 --out kvsnap-1865432100.json
```
Priya: Kicking off run A (prefetch=false) on staging-12 now. ETA ~35m. Will post results + small bench summary here.
Aaron: Thanks. Also Q for reviewers — Sam, can you glance at the compaction change? If it's likely to evict mid-tail items that prefetch would have preserved, we might need a quick revert vs. tweak plan.
Sam: On it. Quick note: I saw increased slot churn in local repro; attaching a tiny snippet from the log where eviction spikes:
```
[2026-06-12T10:12:31Z] shard-3 evict candidate=prefix/ck_... len=64 age=00:27:12
[2026-06-12T10:12:31Z] shard-3 evict -> reclaimed_slot=247 free_slots=12
[2026-06-12T10:12:32Z] prefetch miss for prefix/ck_... fetch_inflight=0
```
Tina: If we see slot churn + fetch miss that's the smoking gun. Priya — if run A matches prod degradation, try run B with prefetch=true and also a variant with compact_window=6h (old value).
Priya: Run A done. Short summary: hitrate 69% (matches prod), evictions up +18% vs baseline, fragmentation P95 +12%. Putting full dump at https://internal.redwood/artifacts/bench-1865432100.tar.gz
Priya: Starting Run B (prefetch=true) now.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: canary-1.4.2-rollback-check on staging at 1865432160
Sam: Thanks for the artifact — looking. Early impression: hot prefixes staying resident in prefetch=true run, reclaim events delayed. Suspect compaction loop aggressively scanning short-lived entries.
Tina: Running a micro-repro that toggles compact_window back to 6h locally — will post results.
Aaron: OK plan so far: 1) Priya finish B and variant with compact_window=6h; 2) Sam open a small PR to make scrub-window configurable per workload with an opt-backoff flag; 3) Tina prepare a small canary of 1.4.2 with compact_window=6h for production canary (if results positive we do fast rollback). Owners: Priya (bench + artefacts), Sam (PR + code review), Tina (canary).
Priya: Run B finished: hitrate 81%, evictions returned to baseline, fragmentation P95 back to normal. Artifact: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/bench-1865432100-prefetch.tar.gz
Priya: Variant with compact_window=6h (prefetch=false) also brought hitrate back to 80% — so both prefetch and longer compact window mitigate the regression.
Sam: Good — I'll draft PR that exposes compact_window as per-workload config with safe defaults and add a telemetry flag. Pinging @Aaron for urgency label.
Aaron: Please add urgent tag and add a short rollback playbook in the PR description (how to flip compact_window or toggle prefetch). If canary looks good Tina, then we can roll the fix to prod tomorrow morning.
Tina: Canary scheduled for tonight at 01:00 UTC. I'll report back within 2h after warmup.
Aaron: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: Sam will add a unit test for compaction behavior, Priya will add a small perf regression test in the bench harness. We'll close once canary green + PR merged. :thumbsup:
Priya: Noted. I'll paste the minimal repro steps in the PR too.
Sam: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/kvcache/pulls/4229 — description + rollback steps included.
Tina: Canary passed after 2h warmup. Hitrate stable ~81%. No error spike.
Aaron: Awesome. Merging plan: Sam merge when green + Priya confirm perf regression test in CI, Tina will coordinate prod roll.
Priya: Perf CI job added: kvcache-prefetch-smoke. Will monitor results.
Aaron: Closing thread once PR merged and CI passes. Thanks all.
